title: Tips for Pet Groomers to Boost Sales - EnvisionNow

facts.fact: A blog post attributed to Accenture states that 91% of consumers prefer brands that provide personalized offers and recommendations.
facts.quote: Statistics show that 91% of consumers prefer brands that provide personalized offers and recommendations (Accenture).

facts.fact: The page cites CXL Institute for the claim that it takes just 50 milliseconds for a potential client to form an impression about a pet grooming studio.
facts.quote: Research reveals that it takes just 50 milliseconds for a potential client to form an impression about your pet grooming

facts.fact: The page cites Marketing Metrics for a 60-70% probability of selling to an existing client.
facts.quote: Data indicates that the probability of selling to an existing client is 60-70%, while the probability of selling to a new client is only 5-20% (Marketing Metrics).

facts.fact: The page cites Marketing Metrics for a 5-20% probability of selling to a new client.
